benchmark.scope: Warm single-thread pricing for two assets; excludes data ingestion, worker startup, network transport and rendering.

limitations: Only one exchange, two crypto assets and 14.75 days; no FX/metals validation.
A fixed panel of nine Beats contracts and six Steps contracts is tested each minute; this is not an exhaustive strategy search.
Historical nearest-neighbour paths and 1.5x shocks do not bound unseen regime changes.
The 18-hour former holdout has been inspected previously. These results are diagnostic and cannot establish independent final validation.
No fees, external hedging, exchange outages or actual order acceptance latency are simulated.
High-frequency adversaries and correlated portfolio risk have deterministic engineering tests and a design, not a full live-capital validation.

protocol.reason: This six-hour interval has not been loaded into this project or used for V2 model selection. Freeze before public acquisition.
protocol.rule: One snapshot per minute; carry convention; all 864 Beats cells and 6 Steps groups; compare raw conditional probability with global baseline; one deterministic uniform contract and one highest baseline-expected-payout quoted contract per asset/minute; no tuning on this window.
protocol.limits: Historical event-time evaluation; no observed receipt times, true client latency, fees or automated real capital approval. Six hours is short.

freshValidation.conclusion: A new six-hour historical check, not production certification. Inspect prediction and player-selection outcomes; do not tune this model on this interval.

previousModel.validationStatus: Reused historical test is diagnostic; fresh forward validation pending
previousModel.uncertainty: Calibration buffer is an empirical stress envelope, not a simultaneous coverage guarantee.

protocol.training: Event paths before 2026-09-09T00:00:00Z; recompute every feature scale, volatility floor and jump limit on this prefix only
protocol.score: Brier on fixed common full-board contracts; both Beats conventions independently; Steps five classes
protocol.risk: score bins merged until >=32 distinct anchors and >=8 hours, horizon and state with explicit pooled fallback; center monotone isotonic; risk hourly bootstrap upper residual and Wilson effective-anchor support floor; Steps coherent ordered exceedance bounds
protocol.evaluation: Sep15-18 already observed, diagnostic only; no independent V4 performance claim from this interval
protocol.unchangedPolicies: 94% budget, 50 cap, minimum odds 1.01, equal-log-increments utility are declared product choices, not uniquely market-implied
protocol.stress: 1.5x return scenarios retained for threshold geometry, no longer asserted as nominal probabilities

developmentCorrection.reason: Coarse cumulative center bins created zero-probability exclusive middle tiers. Preserve a five-class mixture with Jeffreys half-count smoothing instead; use monotone risk curves only as upper bounds for Steps.
developmentCorrection.selection: Same pre-diagnostic candidate weights; no retuning weights on diagnostics.

qualityPolicy.interpretation: Explicit product minimum, not an empirical optimum or actual-return guarantee
qualityPolicy.steps: Constrained utility optimization includes the nominal lower bound, with cent-rounding reserve.

stepGeometry.objective: Divide same-direction positive price moves into four equal-frequency outcome tiers before legal-tick constraints. Scenario-wise maximum of quartiles for common candidate contracts.
stepGeometry.why: Previous .60/.80/.93/.99 absolute-return thresholds plus 1.5x stress made all four tiers rare and the honest risk bounds incompatible with player-return quality. The first threshold is now one positive attainable displacement.
stepGeometry.calibration: Chronological training through Sep09, center selection Sep09-12, independent risk fit Sep12-15.

protocol.allocationReason: Reserve three full days for each calibration stage; one-day risk cells were too uncertain to support useful odds. Do not reduce confidence settings using diagnostic outcomes.
protocol.riskEnvelope: Add local and unconditional probabilities to calibrated upper bounds, for Beats probabilities and each Steps cumulative tail. Preserve fitted center and calibration curves.
